title: Commented-out layout calculation
description:
Layout-quality rule — a hide, field-entry, tooltip or label calculation on a layout object consists entirely of a comment. The calculation never evaluates, so the intended behavior is silently disabled.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Broken Calculation /*Commented Out*/" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A calculation wrapped entirely in /* ... */ evaluates to nothing. A hide condition, field-entry condition or tooltip that was disabled this way stays disabled forever without any visible trace in Layout mode.
rule.remediation: Restore the calculation or clear the slot entirely — an empty slot states intent, a commented-out one hides it.
